result.title: MammoSeek: A Mammography Agent with selective zooming for grounded reports
result.summary: Radiologists read a screening mammogram by first forming a global impression of the four views and then selectively magnifying suspicious regions before assigning a BI-RADS assessment. MLLMs, in contrast, see the whole image at a fixed, reduced resolution, which makes sub-millimeter calcifications invisible, and they perform close to chance on mammography. Therefore, we present MammoSeek, a mammography agent that reproduces this reading process. After forming an impression of each breast, the agent performs selective zooming: it decides by itself which detector candidates deserve a closer look and inspects only those on full-resolution views. Guided by a BI-RADS assessment skill, it then assigns a category and generates a localized, lexicon-structured report for each breast; its assessment is combined with image-model scores in a decision layer to decide recall. On an internal (EMBED) and an external (VinDr-Mammo) dataset, \ours reaches exam-level AUCs of 0.824 and 0.818, far above other MLLMs, mammography agent and CNN classifiers. Selective zooming also outperforms both no zooming and forced zooming in localization, structured-report F1 and recall decisions at low cost.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MammoSeek 乳腺钼靶 agent：先对四视图形成整体印象，再自主判断哪些候选病灶区域值得放大，仅在原分辨率视图上细看这些区域，随后在 BI-RADS 技能引导下给出分级和结构化、带定位的报告，并与图像模型分数在决策层融合以决定召回；在 EMBED 与 VinDr-Mammo 上取得 0.824/0.818 的检查级 AUC。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「自主选择性放大」是模型自决的视觉证据获取环节，与 LOOK 类问题直接相关；文中 no-zoom / forced-zoom 对比可供核查动态证据筛选的收益与成本，但手段是外部裁剪而非内部 latent 状态。
